'''2007 Corellia Regionals Wes Cobb LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Wes Cobb]] at [[2007 Corellia Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Not So Bad
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
